title: EgressRule
description: A network egress rule that controls which external domains the environment is allowed to reach. Each rule identifies a target domain and, optionally, a set of HTTP headers to inject into every matching outbound request.

transform.description: Headers to inject into requests matching this rule. Key: header name (e.g., "Authorization"). Value: header value (e.g., "Bearer your-token").

domain.description: The domain pattern to match for this rule. Use an exact hostname (e.g., `github.com`), a wildcard prefix (e.g., `*.googleapis.com`), or `*` to match all domains.
